sentences.text: Dr. Umesh Manshore, learned counsel for the appellant.
Shri Surendra Kumar Gupta, learned Public Prosecutor fo  respondent/State.

Heard on I.A.No.2238/2025, first application under Section 430 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C.) for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of the appellant- Rajesh Waskale.
The appellant stands convicted under Sections 376(3) of IPC, Section 5(L)/6 and 5(J)/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo 20 years R.I. with fine of Rs.2,000/-, 20 years R.I. with fine of Rs.2,000/- and 20 years R.I. with fine of Rs.2,000/-
with usual default stipulation.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant while taking exception to this impugned judgment submits that appellant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
He has not committed any offence.
The trial Court has not appreciated the evidence in its right perspective in recording the conviction and sentence against the appellant.
There are material contradictions and omissions in the statement of the witnesses.
Impugned judgment has been passed ignoring serious infirmities and anomalies.
The appeal being of the year 2025 is not likely to be heard finally in near future.
Appellant has fair chances of success in this appeal.
Hence, under such circumstances prayer is made for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has prayed for dismissal of the application for suspension of sentence.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
The age of the prosecutrix was found 13 years when she was recovered from the custody of the appellant.
The DNA report has been found positive.
At this stage, we are not considering the issue relating to the age of the present appellant at the time of commission of offence.
